title: Prospectivity deconfliction and rapid model-switch playbook
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Purpose: Build an operational playbook + signal scoring rubric that lets Sales/Success/SREs detect emergent competitor model risks for enterprise customers and execute a pre-authorized rapid model switch with minimal customer disruption. Scope: draft scoring inputs, thresholds, automated alerts, manual escalation steps, companion support templates, and a lightweight A/B rollback plan. Out of scope: changes to pricing or long-term contractual negotiations (handled by Legal and Sales) and any kernel/runtime changes that require infra-level releases.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible signal scoring formula documented and validated on 3 historical incidents (synthetic and production)
Automated alert rule created in monitoring (Grafana/Alertmanager) that fires at 'medium' and 'high' thresholds
Runbook pages authored in Confluence with step-by-step actions for low/medium/high risk with owners and expected SLAs
Two tabletop drills executed with SRE and Sales with captured lessons and postmortem actions
Support templates (email/Slack) and customer communication snippets approved by Legal and CSM
runbook_summary: Signal inputs: regional 5m availability delta, 99p latency shift, token-price shock (>15% change vs baseline), API contract delta (schema changes detected), error-rate spikes (4xx/5xx), and substitution-quality signals from evals (BLEU/ROUGE proxy). Score buckets: 0-29 green, 30-59 yellow (investigate), 60-79 orange (prepare fallback), 80+ red (auto-fallback candidate). Actions: green=monitor; yellow=assign owner, validate model behavior on synthetic workload; orange=notify Sales/CSM + prepare canary route with pinned fallback variant; red=execute rapid switch to fallback for affected routes, notify customers, and open incident ticket. Post-action: capture metrics pre/post, cost delta, and customer impact note for RCA.
example_thresholds: Availability drop: regional availability <98% and delta >=2% over 30m => +25 score
Price shock: public token price change >=15% => +15 score
API contract delta: any breaking schema change detected in model spec => +30 score
Error rate: sustained 5xx increase doubling baseline over 5m => +25 score
Eval-quality: automated regression detection against baseline prompts (>=8% drop in pass-rate) => +30 score
actions_by_bucket: GREEN (0-29): Keep monitoring. Add to weekly model-signal digest. Owner: PM-cust-intel.
YELLOW (30-59): Create investigation ticket, run synthetic workload against candidate fallback, inform SRE lead and assigned CSM. Target: investigation within 2 business hours.
ORANGE (60-79): Prepare canary route; pre-warm caches for fallback variant; notify Sales/Legal for enterprise exposure; runhold for 1-hour canary then evaluate metrics. Target: canary within 4 hours.

RED (80+): Execute pre-authorized fallback for impacted customer routes (automated routing rule); open incident with P1 tag; CSMs to send notification using approved template. Target: fallback executed within 30 minutes of alert when safe to do so.
telemetry_queries: PromQL: sum(rate(model_request_errors_total[5m])) by (region, model) / sum(rate(model_requests_total[5m])) by (region, model) > 0.02
SQL (telemetry): SELECT region, model, percentile_cont(0.99) within group (order by latency_ms) as p99 FROM requests WHERE ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' GROUP BY region, model
Monitoring hook: alertmanager rule file path: ops/alerts/model_switch_rules.yaml (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pulls/1892)
